question: How are the IGVs moved on the Honeywell APU?

options.a: By an electric gear train
options.b: By an actuator connected to an operating rod by a quick release pin
options.c: By pneumatic bellows using turbine discharge air

question: What electronic data is used by the Honeywell ECB for airflow control?

options.a: Load compressor inlet temperature only

options.c: The ADIRU barometric corrected altitude

question: What type of valve is used for the Honeywell APU load compressor bleed control?

options.a: Gate type

options.c: Check valve

question: How is the position of the Honeywell IGVs monitored by the ECB?

options.c: By an optical encoder on the gear train

question: Where is the visual position indicator for the Honeywell bleed control valve located?

options.a: On the ECB front panel
options.b: Directly on the bleed control valve
options.c: On the cockpit center pedestal

question: What is the function of the Honeywell surge control valve during APU shutdown?

question: Which component monitors the load compressor inlet pressure and temperature on the Honeywell APU?

options.a: The P1/T1 probe in the tail cone

question: How is the Honeywell air intake flap moved?

options.a: By an electric actuator
options.b: By a pneumatic ram
options.c: By fuel muscle pressure

justification: The component location diagram (page 471) identifies the 'AIR INTAKE FLAP ACTUATOR' as an electrical component controlled by the ECB.

question: What is the result if the Honeywell ECB detects a surge condition?

options.a: It reduces generator load by 50%
options.b: The bleed control valve is positioned to discharge air to the exhaust

question: Which unit is responsible for processing orders from the steering hand wheels and rudder pedals to command nose wheel steering?

question: Where are the normal braking servovalves located on the aircraft?

question: What is the dual function of the normal braking servovalve?

options.a: To regulate braking pressure and control anti-skid pressure
options.b: To switch between green and yellow hydraulic systems
options.c: To measure wheel speed and brake temperature

question: During in-flight braking (when gear lever is set to UP), what is the status of the anti-skid function?

options.a: It is active on all wheels to prevent lockup

options.c: It is only active on the nose wheels

question: What is the purpose of the hydraulic fuses located in the braking manifold?

question: When the gear control lever is set to UP, what occurs to the main wheels to stop their rotation before they enter the gear bay?

options.c: The reverse thrust from the engines is used

question: What type of signal is sent from the BSCU to the normal braking servovalves?

options.b: Variable control current

question: In alternate braking mode without anti-skid (accumulator pressure only), what is the maximum pressure to which the ABCU limits the brakes?

options.b: Normal Servovalves
options.c: The Parking Brake Control Valve

question: What component gives hydraulic priority for brake supply to the parking brake over other systems?

options.c: The BSCU logic circuit

question: Where are the two center tank water drain valves physically accessed on the aircraft?

question: Which aircraft variant has only two wing drain valves compared to the standard configuration?

question: What is the purpose of the remote inlet on the wing water drain valves?

question: During the water contamination test, how is the purger tool utilized?

question: What volume of fuel must be drained to ensure proper water removal from a tank during the daily check?

options.c: Fuel vapors can cause a sudden loss of aircraft hydraulic pressure

question: According to environmental precautions, how should waste fuel or oil be stored?

options.c: Poured back into the aircraft center tank for recycling

question: What is the designated safety area radius around an aircraft with open fuel tanks?

question: How is the fabric vapor seal below the center tank ventilated?

question: What protection is provided to the aircraft structure from a potential ground fire igniting fuel tanks through the vent ducts?

question: What is the function of the rubber check valve installed in the vent line of the wing tanks?

options.b: To prevent air from entering the tank during high-speed maneuvers

question: How long must the fuel tanks be ventilated before checking the fuel-gas concentration with a combustible gas indicator?

question: What must be avoided regarding electrical equipment within the safety area if the equipment is not spark-proof?

question: When entering a fuel tank through a manhole access panel, what specific warning is given regarding internal components?

options.c: Always hold on to the FQI probes for stability

question: Why is it forbidden to touch or push against the Magnetic Level Indicators (MLI) while inside the fuel tank?

question: What is the requirement for a 'Safety Person' during work inside the fuel tank?
